item.text: {"action":"batch","arguments_json":"{\"calls\":[{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-m\",\"py_compile\",\"work.py\"]}},{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import copy,json; from work import evaluate\\ncases=[({'declared':['b','a','a','ignored'],'saved':{'a':{'kind':'file','hash':'1'},'b':{'kind':'file','hash':'x'},'ignored':{'kind':'file','hash':'old'},'extra':{'kind':'file','hash':'old'}},'current':{'a':{'hash':'1','kind':'file'},'b':{'kind':'file','hash':'y'},'ignored':{'kind':'file','hash':'new'},'extra':{'kind':'file','hash':'new'}}},{'ignored':['ignored']},{'needs_review':True,'changed':['b']}),({'declared':['gone','never','new'],'saved':{'gone':{'kind':'file','hash':'x'}},'current':{'new':{'kind':'file','hash':'y'}}},{'ignored':[]},{'needs_review':True,'changed':['gone','new']}),({'declared':['x'],'saved':{},'current':{}},{},{'needs_review':False,'changed':[]})]\\nfor r,p,want in cases:\\n br,bp=copy.deepcopy(r),copy.deepcopy(p); got=evaluate(r,p); assert got==want,(got,want); assert r==br and p==bp\\nprint('custom checks passed')\"]}},{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import json; from work import evaluate\\nwith open('requests.json',encoding='utf-8') as f: requests=json.load(f)\\nwith open('policy.json',encoding='utf-8') as f: policy=json.load(f)\\nwith open('report.json',encoding='utf-8') as f: report=json.load(f)\\nactual=[evaluate(request,policy) for request in requests]\\nassert report==actual,(report,actual)\\nprint(json.dumps(actual,sort_keys=True))\"]}},{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"git\",\"diff\",\"--check\"]}},{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"git\",\"diff\",\"--\",\"work.py\",\"report.json\"]}}]}"}
